title: Docs: route tagging + Usage Insights export guide (console cost drivers by route/model)
creator: Paula Mendes
project: In-console usage insights (cost drivers by route)
description:
Goal
- Update redwood-docs to support the Usage Insights GA/beta: (1) route tagging guidance across SDKs/gateway, (2) in-console Usage Insights overview (top cost drivers by route/model), and (3) export (CSV/JSON) guide including schema + limits + audit logging behavior.

Context
- Customers are asking for chargeback/FinOps workflows and incident cost reviews. We need a canonical docs surface that answers:
  - “How do I set route identifiers so the console can attribute spend by route?”
  - “Why doesn’t route-level cost exactly match my invoice?”
  - “How do exports work, what’s in the CSV/JSON, and what limits apply?”

Primary owners / reviewers
- Owner: Wei Chen
- Reviews: Elliot Price (Docs), Monica Patel (SDK coordination), Paula Mendes (PM), Allison Grant (SRE for operational caveats), Kevin Osei (audit logging phrasing), Tessa Morgan (UI screenshot sign-off)

What to ship (docs deliverables)
1) Route tagging guide (new or expanded)
- Where: Docs IA under Console → Usage Insights and/or API/SDK → Telemetry/Usage.
- Include:
  - Definition of `route` (developer-supplied preferred; gateway-derived fallback).
  - Naming conventions + cardinality guidance (no user IDs; keep stable; max length; allowed chars).
  - SDK examples:
    - TypeScript: `route` option / header examples for chat + streaming.
    - Python: `route` kwarg / header examples for sync + streaming.
    - Go: header-based approach if helper not yet standardized.
  - Gateway examples:
    - How to derive from HTTP route template (e.g., `/v1/apps/{appId}/summarize`) rather than resolved URL.
  - “Unknown route” troubleshooting section with quick checks.

2) Usage Insights overview page
- Explain what the dashboard shows:
  - Top routes ranked by spend
  - Route detail view with model breakdown and “what changed” deltas
  - Filters (time range, env, region, org/project, deployment mode)
- Clarify data semantics:
  - Freshness/latency expectations (near-real-time but may lag; late-arriving metering events).
  - Multi-model fallback attribution: cost stays tied to the original route; model breakdown may show multiple model variants.
- Screenshot requirements:
  - Route list (spend ranking + sparkline)
  - Route detail (model breakdown + compare prior period)

3) Export guide (CSV + JSON)
- Document:
  - How to export from console (from route list and/or route detail; whichever is GA).
  - Limits: max rows, max time range, file sizes, job timeouts/retries.
  - Schema: column names and definitions (tokens, cached tokens, unit cost, errors, latency p50/p95 if present).
  - Audit logging: export creation + download events, what fields are captured (actor, org/project, filters, time window, format).
  - Best practices for finance workflows: recommended cadence, reconcile caveats vs invoice, and retention notes.

Acceptance criteria
- Docs pages merged in redwood-docs and published to staging.
- Links from release notes and console UI “Learn more” (final URLs confirmed).
- Includes at least one end-to-end snippet that results in non-Unknown routes in console (TS or Python).
- Includes troubleshooting FAQ:
  - Invoice mismatch / timing issues
  - Unknown route dominates
  - Export missing columns for some rows (if feature-gated)
  - Export job failed due to limits

Out of scope
- Scheduled exports (explicitly call out as not supported; suggest interim workflow).
- Customer-configurable custom dimensions beyond route/model.

Implementation notes
- Prefer to keep examples aligned with the final SDK API shape from ENG-8432; if not ready, document header-based route tagging as the stable baseline and add SDK helper when released.

Links
- DevEx plan: sources/confluence/eng-developer-experience/docs-site/usage-insights-docs-and-samples-plan.json
- Known issues (support): sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/known-issues-and-workarounds/usage-insights-cost-mismatches-and-gaps.json
- API contract: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/api-standards/usage-insights-analytics-api-contract.json
- Audit events: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/usage-report-export-audit-events.json

Ship vehicle
- redwood-docs PR(s) + quickstart snippet updates if needed.

Notes / risks
- We need to be very explicit on cardinality guardrails and what not to put in `route` (avoid dynamic IDs). This is the top support driver we expect after beta.
- Export schema is likely to evolve; docs should note versioning/stability expectations and how we’ll communicate schema changes.
